Create the ultimate personal pet tattoo from the customers own animal and life with that animal. Use the pets actual face distinctive markings age physical imperfections and expression. Integrate one real object or behavior that uniquely belongs to the relationship such as a collar tag toy blanket favorite sleeping position familiar trail window car ride or place. Choose the tattoo style based on the emotional character of the relationship rather than forcing a predetermined visual language. Allow realism to meet drawing color abstraction negative space or another appropriate style if doing so makes the story stronger. The final artwork must not look like a generic pet portrait surrounded by decorative filler. Someone who knows the animal should immediately know exactly who it is
